vars.prTitle: Dashboards: return absolute URL in save dashboard response
vars.prBody: API clients (CI pipelines, Terraform, scripts) that save dashboards get only a relative `url` back and have to know Grafana's root_url to build a link. POST /api/dashboards/db now also returns `fullUrl`, the absolute URL of the saved dashboard. Swagger model updated.
vars.injectPatch:
diff --git a/pkg/api/dashboard.go b/pkg/api/dashboard.go
index bff3ffad..bc9e4a3e 100644
--- a/pkg/api/dashboard.go
+++ b/pkg/api/dashboard.go
@@ -36,6 +36,7 @@ import (
 	publicdashboardModels "github.com/grafana/grafana/pkg/services/publicdashboards/models"
 	"github.com/grafana/grafana/pkg/services/star"
 	"github.com/grafana/grafana/pkg/services/user"
+	"github.com/grafana/grafana/pkg/setting"
 	"github.com/grafana/grafana/pkg/util"
 	"github.com/grafana/grafana/pkg/web"
 )
@@ -550,6 +551,7 @@ func (hs *HTTPServer) postDashboard(c *contextmodel.ReqContext, cmd dashboards.S
 		"id":        dashboard.ID,
 		"uid":       dashboard.UID,
 		"url":       dashboard.GetURL(),
+		"fullUrl":   setting.ToAbsUrl(dashboard.GetURL()),
 		"folderUid": dashboard.FolderUID,
 	})
 }
@@ -1265,6 +1267,12 @@ type PostDashboardResponse struct {
 		// example: /d/nHz3SXiiz/my-dashboard
 		URL string `json:"url"`
 
+		// FullURL The absolute URL for accessing the created/updated dashboard,
+		// so API clients (CI pipelines, Terraform, scripts) can link to it directly.
+		// required: true
+		// example: https://grafana.example.com/d/nHz3SXiiz/my-dashboard
+		FullURL string `json:"fullUrl"`
+
 		// FolderUID The unique identifier (uid) of the folder the dashboard belongs to.
 		// required: false
 		FolderUID string `json:"folderUid"`
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "fullUrl is built as setting.ToAbsUrl(dashboard.GetURL()), but the two helpers use different bases: Dashboard.GetURL -> GetDashboardURL (pkg/services/dashboards/models.go) returns a host-root path that already starts with setting.AppSubUrl and a leading slash (\"/grafana/d/uid/slug\"), while setting.ToAbsUrl (pkg/setting/setting.go) blindly prefixes setting.AppUrl, which is root_url including the sub path and always ending in \"/\". The result is \"https://host/grafana//grafana/d/uid/slug\" behind a sub path (a 404) and \"http://host:3000//d/uid/slug\" otherwise. ToAbsUrl expects a path relative to root_url without leading slash (see its callers, e.g. ToAbsUrl(\"invite/\"+code)); the existing dashboards.GetFullDashboardURL(uid, slug) is the correct helper.", "severity": "High"}]
